docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
A girlhood in a samurai household of Echigo after the Meiji Restoration, and a new life in America, told by the daughter herself.

From Standard Ebooks · CC0 1.0

Etsu Inagaki Sugimoto (1873–1950), A Daughter of the Samurai, 1925, with an introduction by Christopher Morley (1890–1957). This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from the public repository of its Standard Ebooks edition when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Standard Ebooks edition, CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication); transcription originally from Wikisource. Modified: converted to this format.
